verdict.rationale: Telephony bridging is a fair question for a realtime media relay, since realtime media products can plausibly ship SIP or PSTN gateways, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only QUIC-based MoQ relaying, token-scoped publish/subscribe and relay management, with no mention of SIP, PSTN, dial-in or dial-out.

support.subject: As a developer, phone callers join a session through documented SIP or PSTN dial-in and dial-out
